thread:
Priya Rao: quick flag — billing aggregates for us-west-2 show a consistent undercount between 01:30-03:10 UTC. looks like a recompute gap.
Lars Mikkelsen: what broke?
Priya Rao: sequence: consumer restarted during deploy, many late events landed with event_time older than their ingest_time. our recompute uses `ingest_watermark <= window_end` so anything with delayed ingest_time > window_end got skipped.
Nina Gomez: so predicate is wrong for event-time semantics. changing it systemwide is risky. we should do a targeted backfill for the affected windows.
Samir Patel: agree. two immediate asks: (1) console dry-run that outputs `estimated_rows`, `shard_partition_count`, and cost estimate; (2) ability to split run into smaller shard-groups to avoid hogging shared capacity.
Priya Rao: + add `--rollback-if-regression` flag to backfill that automatically reverts aggregates if smoke-check fails.
console-prod: current console supports range backfills, tenant filters, and `dry_run` which prints `preview_count` only. no automatic rollback implemented.
Lars Mikkelsen: also need a capacity route option: `route:dedicated|shared|burst` — prefer dedicated for billing jobs but fall back to shared with backpressure.
Nina Gomez: param `max_shard_group=3` and `stagger_seconds=30` will help. also require `run_owner` metadata so we can page correctly.
Priya Rao: I ran a dry-run for tenants tagged `billing=true` over 01:30-03:10. output: `preview_count=72k`, `est_shard_groups=5`, `est_cost_usd=24.60`, `est_wall_seconds=4200`.
Samir Patel: cost OK. staging idea: run first 2 shard-groups with `route=dedicated` then ramp remaining groups to shared. ensures we hit SLOs without overcommitting tokens.
Lars Mikkelsen: question on dedupe: recompute reads raw events and re-aggregates, it's idempotent if we replace windows atomically. can we do atomic window swap?
Priya Rao: we have a `window-swap` pattern: compute new aggregates to temp table then atomically rename. smoke-check compares pre/post metrics.
console-prod: suggestion: after dry-run, surface `Promote -> Split & Route` flow that pre-fills `shard_groups` and `route_plan`. adds a confirmation modal that shows estimated cost and `dedicated_token_cost` so finance can be looped in.
Samir Patel: also request `dry_run` writes a record to audit log with payload and estimated_cost so it's discoverable.
Nina Gomez: for safety, require `approval=true` for any run with `est_cost_usd > 50` or `est_shard_groups > 10`.
Priya Rao: launching first wave now: params `shard_groups=2`, `route=dedicated then shared`, `stagger=30s`, `cancel_timeout=4h`, `rollback_on_diff_pct=0.2%`. tagging #replay-ops.
infra-bot: replay job enqueued 0xaff1, owner=Priya Rao, shard_groups=2, route_plan=[dedicated,shared], cancel_after=4h. link: https://console.internal/replays/0xaff1
Samir Patel: watching SLO dashboard. will escalate to infra if error rate >3x baseline.
Lars Mikkelsen: action items: Nina add split/run UX ticket, Samir monitor & abort rules, Priya run & report smoke-check, Lars propose event-time vs ingest-time RFC.
Priya Rao: will post smoke-check result in thread within 2h. thanks everyone :rocket:
